Title: Wonder Woman: Rebirth Vol 1 1

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman:_Rebirth_Vol_1_1

Markdown Content:
Wonder Woman: Rebirth #1 is a one-shot with a cover date of August, 2016. It was published on June 8, 2016.

## Synopsis for "Wonder Woman: Rebirth"

Wonder Woman finds her memories (which she calls her "story") keeps changing. She returns to her apartment and tests one of her memories by trying to crush the Helmet of War, which she would not be able to do...which she does easily. She then uses her lasso to probe deeper and finds out she had been deceived. Changing her costume, Wonder Woman, goes to Olympus and concludes that it is a lie and vows to find the truth.

## Appearing in "Wonder Woman: Rebirth"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Prime_Earth) "Diana of Themyscira (Prime Earth)")_**(Flashback and main story)**_

## Notes

*   The events of this story lead into two parallel storylines from [_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5 "Wonder Woman Vol 5"): "_Lies_" ([_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5) #1](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5_1 "Wonder Woman Vol 5 1")) and "_Year One_" ([_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5) #2](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5_2 "Wonder Woman Vol 5 2")).
